mapper.select: SELECT c.code, c.name, COUNT(t.id) AS template_count FROM template_category c LEFT JOIN template t ON t.category_code=c.code AND t.enabled=1 GROUP BY c.code,c.name,c.sort_order ORDER BY c.sort_order
SELECT FROM template t JOIN template_category c ON c.code=t.category_code WHERE t.enabled=1 AND t.category_code=#{category} ORDER BY c.sort_order,t.sort_order
SELECT FROM template t JOIN template_category c ON c.code=t.category_code WHERE t.id=#{id} AND t.enabled=1
